 }],

 ],
 'assumptions': [
  'All leaf factors, leaf products, perturbed leaf values, and arithmetic results are real numbers.   'Every quantified rounding model consists of a real u >= 0, a function r: R -> R, and the property: for every real z, there exists a real delta such that |delta| <= u and r(z) = z(1+delta). The error delta may depend on z. Addition and multiplication in the model are respectively r(a+b) and r(ab). No further rounding-format or representability condition is supplied.',
  'The target has the explicit hypothesis (depth(T)+1)u < 1. The tree depth is a natural number, with depth 0 for a leaf and 1 plus the maximum child depth for a node; its successor is cast into R in this inequality and in gamma.',
  'The perturbation bound is gamma(depth(T)+1,u) = ((depth(T)+1)u)/(1-(depth(T)+1)u), applied to each exact leaf product in absolute relative-error form |y-x| <= gamma(depth(T)+1,u)|x|.  ],
 'missing_context': []
}
